name: Quasit

actions.name: Poison Claws
actions.effect: Target must pass PHYS save or be poisoned for 1 minute (disadvantage on attacks and ability checks).

actions.name: Scare
actions.effect: One creature within 6m must pass WILL save or be frightened for 1 round.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.effect: The Quasit turns invisible until it attacks, casts, or loses concentration.

reactions.name: Shapeshift Escape
reactions.effect: When hit by an attack, the Quasit transforms into a bat, centipede, or toad and flies/scurries up to 6m away. +3 to defenses against the triggering attack.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: Can polymorph into a bat, centipede, or toad, or back to its true form. Stats remain the same.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: +1d6 to saves against spells and magical effects.

lore: Quasits are tiny demons that serve as familiars, spies, and tempters for mortal warlocks. Despite their diminutive size, they are cunning and malicious, delighting in corrupting mortals through whispered suggestions and subtle manipulation.
